name: What the Niche Is For
desc: A shrine niche is cut into the wall at shoulder height, and inside it is a coin, old and green and set square. Nobody has taken it. The road does not get easier past this point.
lawfulText: Leave the coin and add one of your own. Whatever it is for, keep it fed.
chaoticText: Take the coin. It has sat there long enough to be owed to somebody, and you are somebody.
